use: Saved source-contract cases for identical before/after review. This is not a verified MCP scenarioSet schema or a campaign snapshot.

sharedContext.actorValidityActionSlotsDoctrineAndAffor: satisfied and held equal across before/after
sharedContext.scoreProfilesCostsCoefficientsAndTimers: unchanged source profiles, no new numeric tuning
sharedContext.candidatePool: Exactly S for each isolated target predicate case. This does not declare the full eligible-state or competing-decision pool.
sharedContext.externalCompleteness: Bounded predicate assumptions only. Actual campaign getters, all alternate states, all competing decisions and native scope encoding are not supplied.

cases.expectedAfterOwnerIntent: eligible lasting_capacity follow-on can be authorized once current project identity is open

cases.expectedAfterOwnerIntent: eligible public_works follow-on can be authorized without replaying old completion rewards

cases.expectedBeforeSource: complete_center_project rejects its historical completed receipt
cases.expectedAfterOwnerIntent: old project completion cannot pay again even when a distinct new project is allowed

cases.expectedBeforeSource: successful completion calls clear_center_state_flags, which clears state episode; reopen mission later requires that episode equality
cases.expectedAfterOwnerIntent: same-episode mission proof survives a valid physical completion

cases.expectedBeforeSource: state episode is removed during a nonterminal physical transition
cases.expectedAfterOwnerIntent: preserve the current center identity for valid continuing lifecycle consumers

cases.expectedBeforeSource: adoption writes registry/stage and receipts but does not assign the receiving current episode to state
cases.expectedAfterOwnerIntent: accepted adoption binds current state identity to the proven receiving episode without replaying earned rewards

classification: Bounded source-contract cases. Native score, probability, availability and lifecycle outcomes remain unresolved until MCP accepts explicit inputs and returns evidence.
postPatchRule: Reuse these exact case IDs and shared assumptions. Append measured evidence without changing this frozen fixture.
